meaning:
δεσμεύω
(δεσμός), [in LXX for אָסַר (Jdg.16:11, al.), אָלַם pi. (Gen.37:7, al.), etc. ;]
1. to put in chains: Luk.8:29, Act.22:4.
2. to bind, tie together: φορτία, Mat.23:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.
For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard, and bound with…
I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
